attributes.name: Fireproof O-Yoroi
attributes.powers:
If proficient with heavy armors, reveal this card to add 1 to your Constitution or Diplomacy non-combat check.

Recharge this card to reduce Combat or Fire damage dealt to you by 2. 

Banish this card to reduce all damage dealt to you to 0; if proficient with heavy armors, bury it instead. 

If you have the Samurai trait, you may recharge this card when you reset your hand.
